                var2 = abs(clause[j])

                W_G[var2-1][var1-1] += 1

def tropicalize_matrix(W_G):
    n = len(W_G)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if W_G[i][j] > W_G[j][i]:

            elif W_G[i][j] < W_G[j][i]:

    visited = [False] * n

        if visited[node]:

        visited[node] = True
        for neighbor in range(n):
            if clauses[neighbor][node-1] != 0 and not visited[neighbor]:

        tree_width = max(tree_width, current_width)
    
    for i in range(n):
        dfs(i, 0)
    
    return tree_width
